warnings: **Mark collision, not a merge:** this sheet's 'RB1'/'RB2' are small tapering REINFORCED-CONCRETE beam sections (0.15-0.20 m wide, variable/'VARY' depth, 2-Ø12mm RB main bars) — completely different members from the STEEL C-channel rafters also marked 'RB1'/'RB2' on S-04/S-05 (the carport and main-roof framing plans). Kept as separate element_ids in their own file per sheet; this is a genuine same-mark-different-member case in the source drawing, not a data-entry duplicate — flagged here rather than silently renamed.

B5B and B6/B6X are tapering beams (0.60 m deep at the wide end down to 0.27-0.33 m at the narrow end) — recorded with the wide-end height_mm and a note carrying the taper; a single height_mm cannot represent a variable-depth member exactly.
